svg.title: IconDie1
svg.desc: The one face of the reroll die, BODY ONLY. Its single pip is drawn separately as IconDie1Pip, in the accent, because a Path.ico is one stroked path with one brush - a glyph cannot carry two inks. The red one is the oldest piece of character a die has, and it is the one face where it reads: on any other face a lone coloured pip would look like a mistake.
